Oyster Therapeutics · brandmark brainstorm, round ten

Rounded, with the linker pearl

Round nine’s 02, with three changes. The right side is rounded off (smoothed more the further right, then re-fitted so the gap between the proteins stays even). The pearl is turned so it splits along the same line as the shell, one half by BRD4 and one by VHL. And the halves are held by a short, thick linker, cut out of the pearl as negative space. The variations try how round, and the linker’s proportions. Structures: PDB 5T35, Gadd et al., Nat. Chem. Biol. 2017; the degrader is drawn generically.

01

Rounded, linker pearl

Round nine’s 02 with its right side rounded off. The pearl is split along the same line as the shell, so one half sits by each protein, and the halves are held by a short, thick linker cut out of the pearl.

The two halves of the SELFTAC, each by its own protein, held by the linker: the whole mechanism in the pearl.
